title: Awesome app!
body: At first I was skeptical, but now I love it. I downloaded a handful of these habit apps to try side by side. The first day I found the habit settings page to be a little fidgety and slightly overwhelming in comparison to some of the others’ more simple design, but soon found that the others felt way too dumbed down in functionality compared to HabitHub. I’m very glad I decided to stick around past first impressions.
author: Spamez

title: Nice app - needs monthly habit function.
body: Needs a monthly habit functionality. Currently only allows weekly habits to be added.
author: Belindabdo8
